item.title: Cat Avoiding Head Pats Becomes Source For Redraws On Twitter
item.description: Cat Avoiding Head Pat refers to a webcomic drawn by Twitter / X user @illust2002 about a cat that avoids getting head pats from someone's hand, dodging it by moving backward and flattening its head in the images. The four-panel comic gained virality in early February 2026 after it became a subject of redraws by artists on Twitter, who replaced the cat with different pop culture characters.

item.title: AI Voice Used To Make Everyone Sing This Slowed Down Song In 'Elades' Meme Trend
item.description: Eladeselesobinubaliepraso or Eladasalasobinubaliepraso nnidalicaperecosaupanero curaso is a series of memes where characters and celebrities are made to sing the song "NO BATIDAO" by ZXKAI using AI, with the song's lyrics often represented phoenetically as "Eladeselesobinubaliepraso." The trend was popularized throughout February 2026 after a version of the meme featuring Cristiano Ronaldo singing the song went viral.

item.title: The 'Geeked Patrick' Reaction Image Has Been TikTok's Go-To Happy React Since December
item.description: Geeked Patrick Star or the Happy Patrick Meme is a reaction image of a pink creature that some believe resembles Patrick Star smiling with its mouth wide open against a background featuring a dolphin, a rainbow and flowers. The meme started spreading on TikTok as early as December 2025 as a reaction image in comment sections, used to react with happiness.

item.title: 90s Educational PC Game Skeleton 'Seemore Skinless' Becomes A Reaction Image
item.description: Skeleton Reading Book or Seemore Skinless Reading is a reaction GIF of a skeleton, Seemore Skinless, wearing green glasses and reading a book, the background changing to show fire, and then lightning, as he flips pages. Seemore Skinless is from the 1997 educational PC game My Amazing Human Body. The GIF became the subject of memes as early as February 2026 as a reaction image and image macro meme. item.title: TikToker 'The_furryous07gamer' Earns Big Following For Cringey, Meme Filled Lip Dub Videos
item.description: The_furryous07gamer is a short-form content creator on TikTok and Instagram Reels known for his meme and lip dub videos, many of which feature modern online slang terms. The_furryous07gamer garnered a steady following throughout 2025 and early 2026, with his videos spreading as examples of cringe content. In January 2026, The_furryous07gamer's "me talking to Geometry Dash" video went viral, inspiring recreations and memes.
